messages:
morgan: Heads-up from vuln triage: found a case where malformed SAML RelayState + role rename allowed a deprovision request to run for the wrong tenant. saw KMS metadata deleted for 2 users and subsequent SCIM creates failing with 403.
ana: do you have a minimal repro/log?
morgan: log snippet: `2026-03-24T02:14:02Z provisioner WARN request_id=rid-zz123 action=deprov target_extid=acct:alice tenant=orchard resolved_extid=alice service=svc_scim user=svc_auth err=unauthorized` followed immediately by: `2026-03-24T02:14:03Z kms INFO envelope_delete envelope_id=e-993 removed_by=svc_scim request_id=rid-zz123` then `2026-03-24T02:14:04Z provisioner ERROR KMSDecryptFailed key_ref="" err="invalid_ciphertext"`
ana: So deprov ran with wrong tenant context and deleted envelope pointer. How did authz allow that?
morgan: Root cause chain: 1) RelayState parsing bug in SAML handler trimmed tenant prefix when RelayState contained trailing slash. 2) RBAC rename changed group slugs, so the service that validates tenant scoping used new slug form and sometimes returned no match -> fallback to global permissive path for legacy svc tokens. 3) Deprov flow had no hard check to ensure envelope_org == current_tenant before delete.
devsec-bot: Vulnerability triage created: VULN-2026-07 severity=high attack_vector=internal_privil escalation=possible
sre-oncall: Immediate mitigation: disable automated envelope deletes until we patch, restore missing metadata from backup for impacted users, and rotate identities for any svc accounts that had permissive fallback.
morgan: mitigation steps taken: 1) feature-flagged envelope_delete in provisioner -> off 2) restored envelopes from latest metadata backup snapshot (s3://kms-meta-backups/2026-03-24-01) for the 2 users 3) rotated svc_scim tokens and added temporary denylist for permissive fallback path
ana: Can you show the query to find affected rows?
morgan: `SELECT id, envelope_id, tenant, external_id FROM kms_metadata WHERE updated_at > '2026-03-24T01:00:00Z' AND envelope_deleted = true;` returned 2 rows. Also `SELECT * FROM provisioning_audit WHERE request_id IN ('rid-zz123','rid-zz124');`
devsec-bot: Recommendation: consider adding an audit invariant check that prevents delete unless a tenant-scoped precondition passes. Also require two-step confirmation for automated envelope deletion on production.
sre-oncall: Also add an anomaly alert: spike in envelope_delete events or delete_by != owner_service -> page immediately. I'll create alert rule.
kms-bot: Action: created alert rule alert_name="kms-envelope-deletes-unexpected" threshold=1/5m scope=prod
morgan: Short-term patch: provisioner change to validate `envelope.owner_tenant == current_tenant` before any delete and return 403 otherwise. Added canary patch to staging.
nana: For postmortem: list fixes: - SAML RelayState parsing tightened + unit tests for trailing slash and encoded forms - RBAC rename rollback shim + contract tests between authz and provisioner - enforce tenant-scoped KMS metadata key - make envelope delete idempotent and require audit_tag and migration_token - add anomaly alert and SRE runbook - rotate svc tokens and rotate affected customer secrets if needed
morgan: Filing follow-ups: ENGSEC-2155 (fix relaystate), ENGSEC-2156 (provisioner precondition + contract tests), ENGSEC-2157 (alert+runbook), ENGSEC-2158 (customer notification draft).
sre-oncall: I've muted noisy paging for the alert while we roll fixes. monitoring: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/alerts/scim-kms
morgan: Canary patch passed, will roll to prod after 30m of monitoring. Marking this thread for postmortem write-up. Thanks folks :thumbsup:
